message.content: {"note_claim": "Mbappé's phrase about 'meter las manos en la mierda' referred to France's willingness to play physically/dirty against Paraguay's style, not an insult calling them 'shit'.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Si tenemos que ensuciarnos las manos, lo haremos. Pensaron que íbamos a presentarnos en esmoquin para jugar, pero también sabemos jugar al fútbol sucio.", "reason": "The page quotes Mbappé saying France can also get their hands dirty and play dirty football in response to Paraguay's physical play, which supports the note's interpretation of the phrase."}

parsed.note_claim: Mbappé's phrase about 'meter las manos en la mierda' referred to France's willingness to play physically/dirty against Paraguay's style, not an insult calling them 'shit'.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Si tenemos que ensuciarnos las manos, lo haremos. Pensaron que íbamos a presentarnos en esmoquin para jugar, pero también sabemos jugar al fútbol sucio.
parsed.reason: The page quotes Mbappé saying France can also get their hands dirty and play dirty football in response to Paraguay's physical play, which supports the note's interpretation of the phrase.
